notes.title: "Restitched: Wardrobe Test" Announced
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/6edff31f50c0dce4ec0e56596ad985b286356f89.jpg

Our incredible dev team have made heaps of exciting progress on the Wardrobe in Restitched! But before we can wrap things up, we need a bit of help in testing these customization features...

This is why we're excited to announce that we've begun prepping for our first-ever private testing phase with the Restitched: Wardrobe Test, which we intend to roll out in the coming months.

Curious about the details?
On our website, we cover loads of info in the full post.. including who will be selected, when it's coming, tester rewards, features, and more:
https://www.trixelcreative.com/post/restitched-wardrobe-test

notes.title: Follow Development with "Restitched: Recapped!"
notes.content:
Howdy-hey, Stuffies,

We know you might be eager to get your plush paws on Restitched, and to help tide you over during the wait we'd like to remind you that we've opened up our development journey so you can follow along with us as we build the game each month!

Starting back in December 2021, we've published a new Restitched: Recapped! development post each month. These posts offer a glimpse into our creative process and first-time development journey. In the posts, you'll see our process us as we learn, grow, and try things out!

Over 25 posts available now (and FREE)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/571ea0361c0139c20468a7b757f191985665f5c5.png
Whether you just want to check out the latest developments or start from the beginning, there's loads of exciting development recaps already available! You can find them on our Patreon - but don't worry, they're free. 

Catch up on Restitched: Recapped! here!

You can also join our "trixel+" Patreon service for only $3/mo (USD) to get early access to select posts (like Recapped!), along with nearly 300 exclusive posts and the opportunity to cast your vote in development polls.

When will we hear more about Restitched?
While we're just a hobbyist team of developers, we're doing our best to push the project forward and have already hit new milestones. We're really excited about where we're headed, and can't wait to share an official, polished update in the (hopefully near) future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/9c276a43e222185ca457fcc5c3ea272e3ca43820.jpg
We're currently working toward a private building test, in which handpicked friends and developers will test the game's primary level editor tools. Afterward, we'll continue working on the final goals needed to produce our second official trailer for the game - which is already underway.

We'd like to thank everyone that supports us along this journey, including all you lovely folks that have wishlisted the game here on Steam. It means the world to us, and we couldn't do this without you!

How can I stay in the loop?
We're still a ways off from any type of release, but if you'd like to be more involved in the Restitched community then you can join our official Discord server! 

Another great way to stay informed is to follow us on social media, like @RestitchedGame on Twitter (X), and trixelcreative on Instagram.
